references.text: The description of the utensils to be made for service in the sanctuary, which were later to be carried by the Levites.
Refers to the holy utensils used in the service of the tabernacle.
The responsibility of the Kohathites to carry the holy objects, including the service utensils.
Similar instructions on using blue cloth and tachash skins to cover holy objects.
Parallel instructions on wrapping holy objects with a blue cloth and tachash skin, and placing them on carrying poles.
The Kohathites carried the holy things on their shoulders, in accordance with the instructions regarding the carrying poles.
Mentions blue fabric (tekhelet) as material for the sanctuary, the same material used to cover the service utensils.
Refers to tachash skins as a covering for the tabernacle, the same material used to cover the utensils.
